name: District Electoral Divisions/Wards ~20 Jan 1919
description: District Electoral Divisions/Wards of Ireland, before partition, as at ~20 Jan 1919 (exact date currently unknown), assembled from Connacht (= 1919 boundaries), Leinster 1919, Munster (= Apr 1907 boundaries), Ulster (= 1916 boundaries). Modified version of the 21 Mar 1921 map. On March 21st 1921, following the formation of Ballycastle Urban District, the DED of Ballycastle was split into Ballycastle Rural and Ballycastle Urban. Additionally, six DEDs (Queenstown Rural/Urban -> Cobh Rural/Urban and Kingstown No. 1-4 -> Dún Laoghaire No. 1-4) and two counties (King's County -> Offaly and Queen's County -> Laois) were renamed in 1920.

OSNI County Series six-inch (1:10,560), County Down sheet 4, Edition 5 (revised 1931)
references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Inner Lighthouse at the tip of the East Twin to a boundary post on the railway at Tillysburn; Edition 3 (1902) and Edition 4 (1920-21) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough east of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).

references.note: Shows the county borough boundary ("Co. Boro. Bdy.") in a straight line from the Antrim shore south of Greencastle to the Inner Lighthouse; Editions 3 and 4 (1901-02) show the same line. The pre-1958 Belfast line in the lough west of the lighthouse is traced from this sheet. Viewed in PRONI's Historical Maps Viewer (OSNI).
